# Crafted Hertz

> Crafted Hertz is an electronic music producer dedicated to authentic, 100% human-crafted electronic dance music, spanning deep house, techno, tech house, nu-disco, afro house, tropical house, melodic house, and peak-time EDM.

- [Official Website](https://www.craftedhertz.com): The official hub for releases, news, and the 24/7 underground radio stream.
- [Discography & Catalog](https://www.craftedhertz.com/catalog.html): Featuring official releases including "Cold Blooded", "In This Galaxy", and "Sunshine".
- [24/7 Live Radio](https://www.craftedhertz.com): Continuous underground electronic music live stream and online radio.

## Artist Identity
- Formerly released music under the artistic pseudonym Xush.
- Deeply rooted in electronic music production since 2001, utilizing a professional studio workflow centered around Ableton Live, analog emulations, and hardware-inspired sound design.
